title: Sego Review Artifact
x-contract-note: RATIFIED (cross-window technical ratification only). NOT Founder or user acceptance. NOT product-release approval. First recorded revision: revisions were not tracked before 2026-09-12, so each schema starts at revision 1; this marker lets a consumer pin and diff the contract source (contract changes land here, not only in the implementation).
description: The persisted review artifact written to .sego/reviews/{id}.json. This is the canonical on-disk representation produced by Sego's code review workflow. Aligned with Rust struct SegoReviewArtifact in runtime/src/code_review/report.rs.

schema_version.description: Schema version for forward compatibility. Current version is 1.

created_at_epoch_seconds.description: Unix timestamp (seconds) when the review was created.

diff_hash.description: Hash of the reviewed diff (binds review/verify/ship to the same code state).

finding_count.description: Number of findings. Must equal findings.length.

highest_severity.description: Highest severity among findings, or null if no findings. Optional in older artifacts.

git_status.description: Git status snapshot at review time (e.g. '## main...origin/main').

raw_text.description: Raw model output text before parsing into findings.

evidence_coverage.description: What the review actually captured, per file. Current builds emit this field but it was previously undeclared here. Consumers deciding whether a 'zero findings' result is trustworthy must read it: an empty findings list with incomplete capture is not evidence that the change is clean. Aligned with ReviewEvidenceCoverage (runtime/src/code_review/report.rs:61-71).

reviewer.description: Local trust metadata identifying the review engine that produced this artifact (for example, sego). Optional for older artifacts. This is not a cryptographic signature.

engine_version.description: Sego engine version that wrote the artifact. Optional for older artifacts.

review_mode.description: Review mode used to produce the artifact, for example model_code_review. Optional for older artifacts.

resolved_provider.description: Governed plugin path only: the provider Sego resolved for the invocation that produced this artifact. Sego's routing decision derived from the model name, NOT a provider-side attestation, and not proof of which model the provider executed. Absent on artifacts written by paths that do not record a route.

resolved_model.description: Governed plugin path only: the model Sego sent the request for. Same caveat as resolved_provider.

invocation_id.description: Governed plugin path only: the caller-minted invocation identity this artifact was produced for, carried through opaquely. Absent when the caller supplied none. Not an execution idempotency key, and not a substitute for Sego's own review id.

resolved_endpoint.description: Governed plugin path only: the endpoint Sego resolved for this invocation, from the same accessor the model client uses. Absent when the provider has no accessor; identity_evidence_gap then names that gap.

identity_evidence.description: Governed plugin path only: strength of the identity evidence. Currently always 'self_reported_resolution' — Sego's own routing decision, confirmed against the wire, NOT a provider-side attestation.

identity_evidence_gap.description: A named dimension Sego cannot observe, so a consumer never infers an evidence gap from a missing field. Currently expected to be null: every routable provider has a base-URL accessor. A non-null value names a provider without one. The field is kept deliberately — the capability to express a gap matters more than the absence of one today, and removing it would be another contract-visible change.

parse_error.description: Optional parse error diagnostic when parsing was attempted but failed or repaired.

parse_repair.description: Optional parse repair/extraction mode used while parsing model output.

severity.description: Review finding severity (snake_case, aligned with Rust ReviewSeverity).

parse_status.description: How the model output was parsed (aligned with Rust ReviewParseStatus).

finding.description: A single structured review finding (aligned with Rust ReviewFinding).

id.description: Finding identifier (e.g. 'f-001'). Has serde default; may be absent in legacy artifacts.

file.description: File path relative to workspace root.

line.description: Line number, or null if not applicable.

evidence.description: Code snippet or evidence supporting the finding.

risk.description: Risk description if the finding is not addressed.

verification_hint.description: Optional hint for how to verify the finding.

evidence_status.description: Optional evidence gate status. Absent or null for legacy artifacts.

Evidence gate status attached by Sego when deterministic validation was possible. These are the seven values EvidenceStatus can serialize (runtime/src/code_review/report.rs:17-32); content_not_captured and content_truncated were missing here even though the implementation already emitted them, so artifacts carrying them failed this schema.
